title: BEST Aim trainer
features:
🎯 Rscripters AimTrainer – Feature List

Executor Support: Works with Xeno, KRNL, Script-Ware, and more

Custom GUI:

Draggable, resizable panel

Start / Stop / Reset controls

Live stats tracker (time, hits, shots, accuracy)

Streak system (current + best streak)

Difficulty Presets: Easy / Medium / Hard (adjusts size, speed, and spawn rate)

Dynamic Targets:

Neon moving spheres

Random spawn positions

Auto-despawn after 10s

Clipboard Discord Button: Click to copy invite link (supports all major executors)

Controls:

K = Kill Switch (instantly closes trainer & GUI)

F4 = Toggle GUI visibility

Infinite Ammo: Automatically refills ammo/clip values for any tool

Performance: Lightweight, efficient spawning system (configurable max active targets)

Session Timer: Adjustable session length with auto-stop
